classification: performance gate diagnosis; not a replacement gate

harness.semantics: Consecutive requestAnimationFrame callback timestamp deltas while the synthetic chart is visible.

observations: The blank control establishes an approximately 16 ms headless Chromium cadence with integer-quantized timestamps under Playwright fixed time.
The canonical application adds a small upper-tail delay: 6-10 of 120 desktop intervals reached 20 ms or more, while medians and means remained approximately 16 ms.
The canonical desktop aggregate fails because two of three nearest-rank p95 values equal the strict 20 ms boundary; the threshold was not relaxed or reinterpreted.

requestAnimationFrame timestamp deltas combine compositor cadence, OS/container scheduling, JavaScript work, rendering work, and unrelated runner jitter. The harness does not bracket applyMid, series.update, applyOptions, layout, or paint, so it cannot attribute the tail to BazaarNama's real-time loop.
The synthetic fixture fixes Math.random to 0.5 and returns an unchanged quote. It is useful for determinism but does not exercise a representative changing-quote sequence.
A narrow exact-state deduplication experiment did not reliably clear the strict gate under repeat execution and was fully reverted. No performance-motivated product change remains.

conclusion.causeClass: scheduler-and-rendering tail observed; code-level cause not established
conclusion.reasonNoProductChange: Changing the live animation without direct work attribution would be speculative and could alter intended tick motion, new-bar rollover, or settings propagation.
conclusion.currentGateDecision: Keep FAIL until a direct, reproducible chart-work benchmark passes the existing intent without changing the numeric budget.

recommendedBenchmark.name: deterministic changing-quote chart work
requirements: Run alone on a pinned reference device or explicitly pinned CPU allocation; execute an idle control in the same job and invalidate the run if the control is unstable rather than subtracting it from product results.
Feed a deterministic sequence of genuinely changing quotes through a test-only entry point, independent of polling, Math.random, and the network.
Bracket the synchronous live update with User Timing marks to report applyMid/series update self-time p50, p95, and max.
Capture a Chromium trace with main-thread task, style/layout, raster, and paint events; report quote-to-next-frame latency, dropped/over-budget frames, paint time, and long tasks.
Use at least 600 updates per scenario and multiple isolated repeats so p95 is not decided by six scheduler samples.
Keep the existing <20 ms intent as a separately defined quote-to-present latency gate; do not treat an uninstrumented free-running rAF cadence sample as chart CPU time.
